_comments: Sets JSONType metadata on Action.Config (Config_ in TypeScript) so CodeGen emits a typed
Config_Object accessor with IActionConfiguration. The interface is authored in
JSONType-interfaces/IActionConfiguration.ts and inlined into the generated entity by CodeGen.
It carries the integration routing keys IntegrationActionGenerator already writes, plus
outputTrustLevel, the per-action trust setting the agent runtime reads (PR #6268).
